profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am part of the logistics and supply chain team, building applications that ensure goods and materials are moved efficiently through the warehouse or distribution centers

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: A member of the Inbound Scheduler 2.0 team at Walmart Labs.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a new automatic system to remodel the current development workflow. This key project allows content writers to create and organize story content, upload assets, and then automatically generates the prototype or final product.
- Boosted productivity and quality of drafting storyboard by developing an interactive web application using React and Redux and also in Vuejs version, that provides a visual environment handling such tasks as conversation trees, game flow, inventory, characters. 
- Built a robust backend server using Nodejs with PouchDB and CouchDB for handling data, user authentication and authorization, uploading assets and interacting with the database.
Implemented 20+ reusable components which automate the generating prototype process for future projects.
- Created development plans, schedule, estimating task durations and conducted daily Scrum meetings to discuss current progress and address any problems the team might be encountering.
Developed an intensive series of  e-learning web applications for the Government using VueJS, JQuery, Javascript, HTML5, and CSS.
- Completed full lifecycle developments within optimization scenarios including designing, programming, testing, debugging, deploying and documentation for 12 performant products in less than 2 years. 
- Created support tools for content writers to make changes on content, gather assets and generate SCORM packages. 
- Created and maintained comprehensive documentation throughout the lifecycle of development, implementation and maintenance.
- Subscribed to modern workflows including automation via Grunt and version control via Git

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of inter-disciplined researchers to develop 2 complex simulation softwares (PBORE-3D and PCORE-3D) for industry applications which are being used by 10 petroleum companies using C#.
- Implemented an automated web service generating software keys for industry customers.
- Responsible for technical support on software’s activation and installation.
- Developed an iOS mobile version of PCORE-3D for effective in-class demonstration using Objective C, C++.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a web application for credit risk assessment (QCA) using .NET and T24 core banking Oracle database. 
- Responsible for optimizing and enhancing functionalities for an automatic file transfer tool (ECM), improved accuracy to 95%.

positions.title: Research Internship
positions.description:
- I was trained as a specialist in software development. My responsibility was to analyze malicious codes, develop new module for existing software and program web-based collaboration software.
- Based on the current trend of using software in state-owned company trends, I develop some integration module such as eDict( dictionary software), eTask( a task management solution) in order to improve product of Bkis named eOffice.
- I participated in Cloud-computing group. My main mission is to research some open source products such as webmail server Zimbra, or Dimdim web conference.
